meta_title: Fonder — a film camera for iPhone
meta_description: Fonder turns your iPhone into a film camera: {{film_count}} films, recipes you set like a camera, and Film Roll — shoot a roll, then develop it.
lang_bar_text: Xem trang này bằng tiếng Việt?
consent_text: This site uses Google Analytics to count visits. OK?
ch1_body: Still mode opens on a recipe, with the white balance and exposure in the corners of the frame. Pick a recipe on any of {{film_count}} films, then set it like a camera: white balance, dynamic range, grain, colour. Still, Cine and Roll.
ch2_body: Films fitted to real camera renders, not filters painted by eye. Halation, grain and the whole look are rendered on the iPhone, in the viewfinder and in the photo.
app_note_developing: Each frame gets the look you loaded. No settings to choose.
app_note_developed: Final photos. The Toffee Neg look is set, so there’s nothing to edit or regrade.
ch3_body: Load a roll, shoot it blind, then develop it all at once — with a border and a date stamp if you like.
ch3_contact_caption: A developed roll, straight from Film Roll.
action_follow_body: Follow Fonder to get the link first.
footer_line: Made in Hà Nội by Trung Hai.
alt_ch1_phone: Fonder's camera in Still mode on an iPhone: choosing a recipe from the strip, then setting white balance and grain from the controls, the viewfinder changing with each
alt_ch2_print: Two boats at the shore of a mountain lake, developed on Toffee Neg
alt_ch2_phone: Fonder on an iPhone, developing a roll of Toffee Neg: twelve frames come up one by one on the contact sheet
alt_ch3_contact: A contact sheet of a developed roll
rteaser_body: A film character plus the darkroom decisions around it. Every recipe Fonder ships, taken apart on one frame — and one scene developed through them all.
